primaryTargetIndustries.whyHighValue: Prestige-driven, premium budget, typically 10–200 staff, high GM projects. Partners view the office as a direct representation of firm credibility.
primaryTargetIndustries.keyBuyingSignal: New partner joining, new lease, rebrand, floor expansion
primaryTargetIndustries.messageAngle: The office that clients walk into defines their first impression of your firm's capability.

primaryTargetIndustries.whyHighValue: ROI-conscious but premium-oriented. CFO approval culture — strong value case lands deals. EOFY purchasing incentive.
primaryTargetIndustries.keyBuyingSignal: AFS licence upgrade, new financial year, new branch office
primaryTargetIndustries.messageAngle: A workspace that demonstrates stability and professionalism — your clients notice.

primaryTargetIndustries.whyHighValue: Fast growth, funding-driven cycles, culture-forward. Office is a talent attraction and retention tool — they invest willingly.
primaryTargetIndustries.keyBuyingSignal: Funding announcement, headcount milestone, leaving coworking, new city expansion
primaryTargetIndustries.messageAngle: The best candidates are choosing companies partly by their workspace — we help you win that decision.

primaryTargetIndustries.whyHighValue: Aesthetically discerning, appreciates design quality, referral network is valuable. Studio/office crossover creates interesting product specifications.
primaryTargetIndustries.keyBuyingSignal: Major project win requiring new office, studio growth, relocation
primaryTargetIndustries.messageAngle: Furniture that reflects the same design intelligence you apply to your clients' projects.

primaryTargetIndustries.whyHighValue: Compliance-driven — WHS and accessibility standards add value. Often larger staff counts in administration roles.
primaryTargetIndustries.keyBuyingSignal: New clinic or administration building, government health contract win
primaryTargetIndustries.messageAngle: Compliant, ergonomic workspaces that meet Australian WHS standards — protecting your team and your liability.
